posts.name: Katrina Kaif
posts.caption: Katrina Kaif is reportedly set to make her Bollywood comeback with Chandni Bar 2 alongside Tabu, directed by Ajay Bahl — her first project after welcoming son Vihaan Kaushal.

posts.name: Diljit Dosanjh
posts.caption: Diljit's Main Vaapas Aaunga with Imtiaz Ali hit theatres June 12 to positive reviews. Meanwhile, his AURA World Tour continues with an LA show at Crypto.com Arena on June 18 and a historic Wembley date in September.

posts.name: Alia Bhatt
posts.caption: Alia Bhatt's Alpha teaser dropped and she's a 'killing machine' in the first female-led YRF Spy Universe film alongside Sharvari and Bobby Deol. Release set for July 3.

posts.name: Priyanka Chopra
posts.caption: Priyanka Chopra shared her support for Alia Bhatt's Alpha teaser, writing 'Ready for your game.' She remains among the few still followed by Karan Johar after his mass unfollow spree. Jee Le Zaraa with Alia and Katrina is in location scouting.

posts.name: Shah Rukh Khan
posts.caption: SRK's King with Suhana Khan, Abhishek Bachchan, and Deepika Padukone is locked for Christmas 2026 release. An intense combat sequence with Deepika was recently filmed in Mumbai. Budget: ₹350 crore.

posts.name: Kareena Kapoor Khan
posts.caption: Kareena joined the viral 'Me at 21' trend, sharing a throwback with Shah Rukh Khan from Asoka. She was among the celebrities unfollowed by Karan Johar in his Instagram strategy reset.

posts.name: Shraddha Kapoor
posts.caption: Shraddha Kapoor's biographical drama Eetha — where she plays legendary Lavani performer Vithabai — has locked an August 28 release date, her first collaboration with director Laxman Utekar.

posts.name: Deepika Padukone
posts.caption: Deepika is expecting her second child with Ranveer Singh and is juggling filming for both King (with SRK) and Raaka (with Allu Arjun and Atlee), using a body double for action sequences.

posts.name: Ranveer Singh
posts.caption: Ranveer is riding high on Dhurandhar: The Revenge crossing ₹1,748 crore worldwide. The OTT premiere landed on JioHotstar with an extended 'Raw and Undekha' cut. Baby No. 2 is on the way with Deepika.

posts.name: Aishwarya Rai Bachchan
posts.caption: Aishwarya stunned at Cannes 2026 with three showstopping looks — from Amit Aggarwal's sculptural 'Luminara' gown to a swan-inspired closing look. Daughter Aaradhya joined her on the red carpet.

posts.name: Rashmika Mandanna
posts.caption: Rashmika's Cocktail 2 with Shahid Kapoor and Kriti Sanon opens advance booking today — it received an 'A' certificate from CBFC. Releases June 19, her second adults-only film after Animal.

posts.name: Samantha Ruth Prabhu
posts.caption: Samantha's Maa Inti Bangaram releases June 19 — a family action drama where she plays a homemaker with a deadly past. Director Nandini Reddy compares it to Rajinikanth's Baasha. Also her debut as a producer.

posts.name: Allu Arjun
posts.caption: Allu Arjun praised Ram Charan's Peddi, calling his performance 'mind-blowing.' His next film Raaka with director Atlee has started shooting — a VFX-heavy sci-fi spectacle expected in 2027.

posts.name: Ram Charan
posts.caption: Ram Charan's Peddi crossed ₹200 crore India gross in just 6 days and hit $3M in North America. It's his first solo film to enter the double century club. Makers are planning a re-edit to boost the second weekend.

posts.name: Jr NTR
posts.caption: Jr NTR's Dragon with Prashanth Neel is pushed to late 2026 or 2027. He's sporting a lean, chiseled transformation, and Anil Kapoor has joined as the villain. Also reportedly reuniting with director Trivikram.

posts.name: Janhvi Kapoor
posts.caption: Janhvi Kapoor earned a career-high ₹8 crore fee for Peddi alongside Ram Charan. She's being called a 'golden-leg' actress in the Telugu industry after back-to-back hits with Devara and Peddi.

posts.name: Ananya Panday
posts.caption: Ananya's recent film Chand Mera Dil with Lakshya under Karan Johar's Dharma received a mixed box office response. She was among the stars unfollowed in KJo's Instagram strategy revamp.

posts.name: Kiara Advani
posts.caption: Kiara and Sidharth Malhotra welcomed baby girl Saraayah! The new mom was last seen in War 2 with Hrithik Roshan and Jr NTR, and is enjoying her new chapter of parenthood.

posts.name: Hrithik Roshan
posts.caption: Hrithik will make a cameo as Major Kabir Dhaliwal in Alia Bhatt's Alpha (July 3). Varun Dhawan's hilarious mimicry of Hrithik on The Great Indian Kapil Show went viral — and Hrithik's gracious response won hearts.

posts.name: Varun Dhawan
posts.caption: Varun Dhawan's Hai Jawani Toh Ishq Hona Hai with David Dhawan released June 5. His Hrithik Roshan mimicry on The Great Indian Kapil Show went massively viral — he later apologized to Hrithik, who loved it.

posts.name: Shreya Ghoshal
posts.caption: Shreya Ghoshal's 'The Unstoppable Tour' across North America kicks off September 4 with 12 arena dates including Boston, Newark, Toronto, Oakland, and LA. Tickets are selling fast.

posts.name: AR Rahman
posts.caption: AR Rahman composed the music for Diljit's Main Vaapas Aaunga (now in theatres) and is confirmed for Mani Ratnam's next film with Vijay Sethupathi and Sai Pallavi. Saira Banu has clarified they are 'separated, not divorced.'

posts.name: Vijay Thalapathy
posts.caption: Vijay's blockbuster Mersal (2017) is set to re-release across 100+ screens on June 19 ahead of his 52nd birthday on June 22. His final film Jananayagan is eyeing a post-election release window.
